title: Baked Santa Fe Chicken
reject_reason: Baked chicken breast over black beans with corn, green chiles, pepper jack and green enchilada sauce; same Tex-Mex baked-chicken-and-bean bake as accepted tex-mex-baked-chicken (and the cowboy-chicken already rejected as its dupe this run), differing only in green vs red enchilada sauce.
